title: Mornington Racecourse Market
summary: Monthly craft market at Mornington Racecourse. 300+ stalls of hand-made, home-made and Australian-designed goods. Street food vendors, live music, animal farm and face painting for kids. Parking $5. Dogs not permitted (service dogs exempt).
description: Monthly craft market at Mornington Racecourse. 300+ stalls of hand-made, home-made and Australian-designed goods. Street food vendors, live music, animal farm and face painting for kids. Parking $5. Dogs not permitted (service dogs exempt).
recurrenceNote: Monthly – 2nd Sunday of month (year-round; occasionally 3rd Sunday due to racing events)
accessibilityNotes: Lower members car park and racecourse; gravel/bitumen/grass; undulating; use caution with prams
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street Mornington; MPRG
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Mornington foreshore walk and Main Street dining
internalNotes: Next confirmed date: 10 May 2026. Runs all year round 2nd Sunday; occasionally 3rd Sunday. Twilight market (Sat 3pm–8pm) listed as TBC – not confirmed for 2026. Future monthly dates follow established pattern.
